free_tier.stated: Trial edition, CNY 0 / permanent: 1 tunnel, random domain / port, 2 Mbps bandwidth rate, 1 GB of traffic per month. [translated]

egress.terms: 1 GB per month on the trial edition.; ingress: udp
egress.free_allowance: 1 GB per month on the trial edition.

interface_detail: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and ARM clients; a dashboard reports traffic and request counts.
tooling: vendor client on Windows/macOS/Linux/Android/ARM plus wg-quick on the local box

limits.value: fixed TCP ports are a paid feature

binding_note: 1 GB per month is 0.0009 TiB, three orders; 2 Mbps would cap a month at about 648 GB anyway.

identity_cost.detail: Registration asks for an email address, a password of at least eight characters and a verification code; an invite code is optional. No phone field appears.

reliability_note: The free tier gets a random subdomain and port; the vendor markets a separate paid tier for a fixed port and unlimited traffic.
confidence_note: Plan table and registration form read first-party today. Whether the free random port survives a client restart is not stated and would need a probe.

evidence.proved: trial edition is 1 tunnel, random domain/port, 2 Mbps, 1 GB per month; UDP is listed as supported
registration is email, password and verification code

notes: Email-only registration and UDP ingress, so it is testable by a user; the byte quota is what rules it out. Fixed TCP ports are listed only on the CNY 15/month tier.

extras.wg_detail: The site states support for TCP and UDP, with UDP named for game hosting, so a WG datagram can ride a UDP tunnel. No WG config is issued, and the free tier assigns a random port.
extras.volume_stated: 1 GB per month on the trial edition.
extras.transit_note: Vendor nodes on a CN2 line carry the tunnel.
